name: discover/discover-search
title: DiscoverSearch
summary: The one search box of a Discover page: a GET form, so every search is a URL that works with no JavaScript. 48px on every pointer.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's and the search landmark's accessible name, e.g. "Search circles".

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example query; never the only label.

props.name: keep
props.description: Parameters to carry through as hidden fields.

props.name: id
props.description: The field's id; unique per page.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label above the field on phones instead of only to assistive technology.

behaviour: A role="search" GET form named by `label`, with a labelled `q` field and a submit button.
Submitting goes to `action?q=…`; there is no client-side filtering and no `cursor` field, so a new search starts at the first page.

focus: The field and button show the `--ring` focus ring.
aria: The field has a <label> (visually hidden unless `showLabel`); the form is a search landmark named by `label`.

theming.brandOverlay: Only the focus ring (`--ring`). The button is the neutral secondary, so search looks the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Full width up to 36rem; the button sits beside the field and wraps under it only when the field would be narrower than 14rem.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-search"
  role is "search"
  label is "Search circles"
  button "Search" min_height 48
  when default shows label "Search circles"
  when idle label is "Search"
end

checks.say: Nothing to carry, no hidden fields.
No cursor field: a new search starts at page one.
